subject.character: ONE stag; a cabin (smoking chimney, door, shuttered window) on his antlers until 3.95; muzzle grays at 0.80 and stays gray; same face throughout
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE badger, vest, visor; in the cab until 6.60, then enters by door
props: red ribbon; yellow bulldozer, ПОД СНОС on its blade; kettle on a hook; inside, seen only from 7.30: mounted trophy head with the stag's own face, glass eyes, gray muzzle
environment: sunny dense forest edge; a stump; birdhouses on trees; dense background
lighting: warm sun behind-left, sky glow behind-right, high contrast; sunbeams through the window; cabin room bright, door bang at 8.10 floods sun in
motion_rule: Camera arcs or orbits every beat, shot size changes from 0.80, trees slide behind, never still; except 7.30: flies in the window. Stag moves his whole body every beat until 5.90.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native; first word on frame one; stress: FI-ni-sha, fi-ni-shi-RO-val, go-lo-VA, fsyeg-DA, DO-mye
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat, silent after 5.9

timeline.a: talks; already lurching under the cabin, body heaves left-right, cabin on his antlers swings from left frame edge to right; face and chest fill lower frame; camera arcs round
talks; heavy step, body swings round; snow on roof, frost on fur, muzzle turns gray; orbit closer
talks; trots forward under the cabin, neck stretched to the ribbon; ribbon runs from birch to blade, badger in cab yawns; arc out to medium
talks; lunges chest-first, ribbon snaps, torn end on tine; snorts steam; low arc
talks; neck jerk flings the cabin onto the stump, it lands upright; sharp arc
talks, face to camera; thrashes antlers against the cabin wall, body swaying side to side, cabin rocks on the stump, shingles burst off; bulldozer lurches in behind; three-quarter arc
blade scoops the stag from behind, legs kick air; bulldozer hauls him off in dust; cabin untouched; whipping arc
shutters fly open; badger leaps off the departing bulldozer by the cabin; camera rushes at the open window, leaves whirl
camera flies in through the window; dust, kettle swings; on the wall his own mounted head, gray muzzle, red ribbon on a tine
door bangs open, badger strides in, flings his visor onto the trophy's antler, trophy swings crooked; arc
badger vaults into the armchair under the trophy, it rocks back and spins half round; kettle clangs; arc closer
badger yanks the red ribbon off the trophy's tine, swirls it like a lasso, body swaying left then right; trophy swings; short arc, badger and trophy fill frame

must_appear: 0.00 his face and chest filling frame, cabin on antlers swinging edge to edge; 1.85 bulldozer, ribbon on blade, badger in cab; 3.95 cabin upright on stump; 5.90 blade scoops stag, cabin intact; 7.30 inside: trophy with his gray face, ribbon on tine; 8.10 badger enters by door
negative_prompt: small hero, static camera, still background, text except ПОД СНОС, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, trophy moving jaw or eyes, trophy head outside the cabin, cabin breaking, running toward camera, camera sliding sideways, conveyor ride, deer running off, a second live deer, two badgers, badger talking, objects falling on the stag, gore, duplicate props, floating objects, extra legs, bent antlers, night, dim light, empty field, foreign accent, a motionless first or last second, wide shot in the first second
